# The Stoned Chef

> Deseronto and Napanee area chip truck serving fresh-pressed smash burgers, hand-cut golden fries, loaded cheese-curd poutines, crispy beer-battered fish & chips, chicken fingers, wraps, and comfort food favourites at 45 Dundas Street, Deseronto, Ontario.

## Core Facts
- **Business Name**: The Stoned Chef
- **Category**: Chip Truck / Quick-Service Comfort Food Restaurant
- **Address**: 45 Dundas Street, Deseronto, ON K0K 1X0 — 5 minutes west of Napanee off Hwy 401 Exit 570 (Hwy 49 South)
- **Parking**: Free on-site plaza parking at 39–45 Dundas Street, Deseronto
- **Service Area**: Deseronto, Napanee, Greater Napanee, Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory, Shannonville, and Belleville, Ontario
- **Phone**: +1-343-337-5810
- **Hours**: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM daily (open 7 days a week, America/Toronto)
- **Website**: https://thestonedchef.ca
- **Full Menu & Prices**: https://thestonedchef.ca/menu
- **Ordering**: Walk-up window ordering daily 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM; when online ordering is active on https://thestonedchef.ca, pickup orders are prepaid online via Square with selectable 15-minute pickup windows
- **Google Rating**: 4.8 out of 5 stars

## Signature Menu Highlights (Prices in CAD)
- **Smash Burgers**: Hamburger ($10.00), Cheeseburger ($11.00), Bacon Cheeseburger ($14.00), Double Bacon Cheese ($18.00), signature Mac Daddy Burger ($16.00), and Crispy Chicken Burger ($12.50).
- **Fresh Hand-Cut Fries & Cheese-Curd Poutines**: Small Fries ($6.00), Large Fries ($10.00), Family Fries ($15.00), Small Poutine ($10.00), Large Poutine ($15.00), Jalapeno Poutine ($19.00), and Special Poutine ($20.00).
- **Crispy Beer-Battered Fish & Chips**: 1 pc Fish & Chips ($16.00), 2 pc Fish & Chips ($25.00), Fish on a Bun ($16.00), Shrimp & Fries ($20.00), and Crispy Onion Rings ($9.00).
- **Chicken, Sausages & Appetizers**: Chicken Fingers & Fries ($15.00), Chicken Caesar Wrap ($15.00), Buffalo Chicken Wrap ($15.00), Mild or Hot Sausages ($12.00), Deep Fried Cheese Curds ($12.50), Battered Mushrooms ($12.00), Jalapeno Poppers ($12.00), Mozzarella Sticks ($10.00), Pickle Spears ($9.00), Mac & Cheese Balls ($8.50), plus Kids Menu meals ($8.00–$10.00) and cold drinks ($2.00–$2.50).
